weakness: No account procedure, approvals, reviews, or monitoring; departed users kept ATS, email, E-Verify, and screening portal access
remediation_plan: Onboarding and termination checklist covering ATS, payroll, suite, E-Verify, screening portal, and accounting; monthly reconciliation; one ATS administrator plus a backup; remove the former Coordinator from the screening portal
milestones: 2026-08-11 E-Verify account deactivated; 2026-08-12 screening portal account removed; 2026-09-30 checklist in use; 2026-10-31 first monthly reconciliation
resources_required: Operations Manager time (1 hour a month)

weakness: Onboarding folder (Form I-9 images, consumer reports, SSN exports) open to all staff; recruiters can open onboarding packets
remediation_plan: MSP restricts the Onboarding folder to the Operations Manager and the Coordinator; ATS recruiter role loses onboarding packet access and sees background check status only

weakness: No time limit for disabling access; MFA registrations not removed; no confidentiality reminder at exit
remediation_plan: Last-day checklist (same as POAM-001) with MFA removal, phone sign-out, and a signed confidentiality reminder; access disabled before notice for involuntary departures
milestones: 2026-08-14 former recruiter MFA registration removed; 2026-09-30 checklist in use

weakness: Payroll administrators use SMS codes; backup console and firewall management login accept a password alone
remediation_plan: Authenticator-app MFA for the 3 payroll administrators; MSP enables MFA on the backup console and firewall with named technician accounts; number matching on suite push
milestones: 2026-09-15 MSP-held logins on MFA; 2026-10-15 payroll MFA switched; 2026-10-31 evidence filed
resources_required: No cost (vendor features); MSP labor included in contract

weakness: No security or privacy training beyond the handbook; no phishing simulations; no payroll fraud training
remediation_plan: Annual online training for all 7 staff; quarterly phishing simulations; payroll diversion module for the Operations Manager, Coordinator, and Owner; reporting card at each desk
milestones: 2026-09-30 payroll fraud module; 2026-10-31 first annual training; 2026-12-31 first simulation

weakness: No review of payroll bank changes, exports, ATS exports, suite sign-ins, or E-Verify users; alerts off
remediation_plan: Turn on payroll alerts for bank changes and report exports (to the Operations Manager and Owner) and suite alerts for forwarding rules and mass downloads; monthly 30-minute review with a checklist; Owner reviews the bank-change report monthly; suite plan upgrade for 1-year log retention
milestones: 2026-09-30 alerts on; 2026-10-31 first monthly review; 2026-12-31 log retention upgraded
resources_required: About $900 a year (suite plan); staff time

weakness: Backups not immutable; 30-day versions; one MSP password can delete them; no ATS or payroll export; key documents outside backup scope
remediation_plan: 90-day immutable versions; signed MOU, contracts, and insurance policy moved into the restricted shared folder; quarterly ATS export by the Senior Recruiter
milestones: 2026-09-30 documents moved; 2026-10-31 backup upgraded; 2026-12-31 first ATS export

weakness: No contingency plan testing; backup never restored; manual payroll never tried
remediation_plan: MSP restores a sample folder and one mailbox; quarterly restore tests recorded; tabletop with the MSP using the P08 runbook; manual payroll drill
milestones: 2026-09-30 first restore test; 2026-11-30 tabletop and payroll drill; 2026-12-31 second restore test

weakness: No reporting rule or time limit; outside authorities and their clocks not identified
remediation_plan: 1-hour reporting rule (POL-03 4.2) on a card at every desk; P08 notification matrix with Florida, DHS, and other-state duties; covered in training

weakness: No wipe records for retired laptops or the returned copier; scanner keeps images on its disk
remediation_plan: Certified wiping or destruction with records for every device leaving the firm; scanner auto-erase on and disk wipe at lease end; ask the lessor for the 2024 copier's wipe record
milestones: 2026-09-30 scanner auto-erase; 2026-10-31 lessor answer; 2026-12-31 wiping procedure in use
resources_required: MSP labor; destruction vendor fees as needed

weakness: Risk assessment never updated (first one in 2026); no reassessment when the AI feature was turned on
remediation_plan: Annual update each July and on major changes under POL-02 A.2 and A.10

weakness: No security requirements, oversight, or monitoring of providers; AI terms allow model improvement use; MSP evidence not received
remediation_plan: Vendor file with breach contacts; payroll vendor SOC 2 reviewed (done 2026-08-20); ATS vendor SOC 2 report obtained and reviewed; AI opt-out and data use addendum; annual MSP questionnaire with evidence; MSP contract amendment
milestones: 2026-08-20 payroll SOC 2 reviewed; 2026-10-31 AI addendum and vendor file; 2026-12-31 MSP amendment and ATS report review
resources_required: Owner and Operations Manager time; about $1,000 a year for the MSP review

weakness: Form I-9 images and consumer reports outside approved systems; no retention schedule; SSN exports kept indefinitely
remediation_plan: Retention schedule (POL-04 4.8); check each paper Form I-9 file, then delete the 214 scan packets; delete consumer report PDFs and onboarding exports; first annual purge of paper Forms I-9 past retention
milestones: 2026-09-30 exports and report PDFs deleted; 2026-12-31 scans deleted after paper check and first purge done
resources_required: Operations Manager and Coordinator time (about 12 hours)
